```{r setup-mascot_server_state, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

### Read a mascot's state in `testServer()`

`mascot_server_state()` returns the latest `id`, `character`, `mood`, `status`,
`bubble` and `gesture` recorded for a mascot on the Shiny server, without mutating
the session. Use it in `shiny::testServer()` unit tests where no browser mounts:

```{r mascot_server_state-call, echo = FALSE}
htmltools::tags$pre(htmltools::tags$code(paste0(
  'shiny::testServer(app_server, {\n',
  '  session$setInputs(save = 1)\n',
  '  state <- mascot::mascot_server_state("helper", character = "',
  studio_character,
  '")\n',
  '  testthat::expect_equal(state$mood, "happy")\n',
  '})'
)))
```

Before any update has been sent for `id`, `mascot_server_state()` returns `id`
and `NULL` for all other fields. Pass `character` when no UI has mounted so
queued character-specific mood, gesture or theme updates can be checked.

```{r mascot_server_state-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot_server_state", studio_character)
```
